entities.name: Rohgahh of Kher Keep
entities.description: A famed kobold warrior and chief ruler of the kobold tribes of the Kher Ridges.

entities.name: Kher Keep
entities.description: Stronghold of the kobolds in the Kher Ridges.

entities.name: Prossh
entities.description: A mighty dragon revered as a deity by the kobolds of Kher Keep.

entities.name: Rograkh
entities.description: Son of Rohgahh who led a rebellion against his father.

entities.name: Rosnakht
entities.description: Descendant of Rohgahh who seized Kher Keep by overthrowing her mother.

events.summary: Rohgahh conceives the ambition to become a god himself and becomes a ruthless overlord demanding tribute and sacrifices on par with Prossh's.
events.quote: he sought to ascend to godhood himself

events.summary: Rograkh, disillusioned by his father's treatment of their people, leads a rebellion to return the kobolds to a more 'righteous' path.
By 4562 AR Rohgahh's descendant Rosnakht has seized Kher Keep by overthrowing her mother.
events.quote: having seized control of the stronghold by overthrowing her mother

relations.note: Rograkh led a rebellion against his father.
Chief ruler of the kobold tribes.
relations.quote: chief ruler of the kobold tribes dwelling in the Kher Ridges region
